proposed_widenings.name: qualified_attunement_requirement
proposed_widenings.justification: The current record can represent that an item requires attunement, but not who is eligible to attune. This wand's core mechanics fit; only the spellcaster-only attunement qualifier is lost.

notes: Authored successfully as a magic_item activation using holding_item, charge_pool, charge_cast lightning_bolt at levels 3-5 with fixed DC 15, dawn recharge, and last-charge destruction. Remaining gap is attunement eligibility qualifier only.
